_meta.description: Curated points of interest used when a live POI API is unavailable or unkeyed. Unlike the transport and lodging mocks, these describe REAL places: names, categories, coordinates, and typical visit durations are accurate to the best of the author's knowledge. They are labelled FIXTURE rather than MOCKED for exactly that reason.
_meta.accuracy_note: Opening hours are deliberately omitted. They change often and a stale opening time presented as fact is precisely the kind of confident-but-wrong output this project exists to avoid. The itinerary planner treats every fixture attraction's timing as estimated.
_meta.admission_note: Admission prices are omitted for the same reason. Where an attraction is free to enter as a public space, is_free is set.

attractions.name: Charles Bridge
attractions.description: 14th-century stone bridge over the Vltava, lined with baroque statues. Extremely crowded from mid-morning; early or late visits are markedly better.

attractions.name: Prague Castle complex
attractions.description: The largest ancient castle complex in the world, including St Vitus Cathedral and the Golden Lane. Grounds are free; individual buildings are ticketed.

attractions.name: Old Town Square and Astronomical Clock
attractions.description: Medieval square with the 15th-century astronomical clock. The hourly apostle procession draws large crowds.

attractions.name: Josefov (Jewish Quarter)
attractions.description: Preserved synagogues and the Old Jewish Cemetery, forming one of Europe's most significant Jewish heritage sites.

attractions.name: Petřín Hill and Lookout Tower
attractions.description: Wooded hill reached by funicular, with a lookout tower giving the best panorama of the city. Poor value in low cloud.

attractions.name: Vyšehrad fortress
attractions.description: Hilltop fortress with a basilica and cemetery, considerably quieter than the castle and with comparable views.

attractions.name: National Gallery — Veletržní Palace
attractions.description: Modern and contemporary art in a functionalist palace. A strong wet-weather option.

attractions.name: Náplavka riverside farmers' market
attractions.description: Saturday-morning riverside market with regional producers and street food. Outdoors with little shelter.

attractions.name: Letná Park beer garden
attractions.description: Hillside park above the river with a large open-air beer garden and a wide view across the bridges.

attractions.name: Municipal House (Obecní dům)
attractions.description: Art Nouveau civic building with a concert hall and period café; among the finest secession interiors in the city.

attractions.name: Nuremberg Castle (Kaiserburg)
attractions.description: Imperial castle above the old town, with a deep well, the Sinwell Tower, and views over the rooftops.

attractions.name: Documentation Centre Nazi Party Rally Grounds
attractions.description: Museum in the unfinished Congress Hall examining the causes and consequences of the Nazi regime. Sober and demanding; allow time.

attractions.name: Hauptmarkt and Schöner Brunnen
attractions.description: Central market square with a 14th-century gilded fountain and a daily produce market.

attractions.name: Germanisches Nationalmuseum
attractions.description: The largest museum of German cultural history, spanning prehistory to the twentieth century.

attractions.name: Schönbrunn Palace and gardens
attractions.description: Former imperial summer residence with extensive baroque gardens. Gardens are free; the palace interior is ticketed.

attractions.name: St Stephen's Cathedral
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral at the centre of the old town, with a patterned tiled roof and a climbable south tower.

attractions.name: Naschmarkt
attractions.description: Long-established market with produce stalls, delicatessens, and casual restaurants.
